name: QE24 ModSettings Probe
author: HackHub Quest Editor
description: QA probe for SDK 0.24 declarative mod settings (Bootstrap.Settings, r239): one setting of every declared type (two toggles, select, text, number, slider) on a probe Bootstrap, plus a quest whose objectives are the QA checklist. Zeis checks in the game how the settings look and function in the Mods menu; the mod logs every load and the claim moment with ModSettings.getAll() so the debug log is machine-readable evidence that the mod reads back what the player set. Rows MS-01..MS-07 in docs/plans/r239-modsettings-probe.md. Nothing auto-starts.
